sanskrit: पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया । यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ॥
hindiTranslation: हे पृथानन्दन अर्जुन  सम्पूर्ण प्राणी जिसके अन्तर्गत हैं और जिससे यह सम्पूर्ण संसार व्याप्त है, वह परम पुरुष परमात्मा तो अनन्यभक्तिसे प्राप्त होनेयोग्य है ॥
englishTranslation: O Arjuna, the supreme person is reached through undivided devotion. All beings dwell within that being, and this entire world is pervaded by that being.
essence: Undivided devotion reaches the one presence that holds all beings.
speaker: Krishna
simpleMeaning: The supreme person is reached through single-pointed devotion. That presence holds all beings within it and fills the whole world.
simpleInsight: You are not reaching something distant; you are turning toward the presence already holding everything together.
detailedMeaning: Now Krishna adds the heart of the path: that supreme person is reached by undivided devotion, because every being already rests within that presence.
modernRelevance: Before a tense meeting with the in-laws over a property matter, you remind yourself that they too live inside the one Krishna describes. Undivided devotion, he says, reaches the person who pervades everyone at that table.
translationLiteral: पुरुषः (person) / सः (that) / परः (supreme) / पार्थ (O Partha) / भक्त्या (through devotion) / लभ्यः (is attainable) / तु (indeed) / अनन्यया (undivided) / यस्य (whose) / अन्तःस्थानि (situated within) / भूतानि (beings) / येन (by whom) / सर्वम् (all) / इदम् (this) / ततम् (pervaded)
insight: Krishna names undivided devotion as the way to the supreme person, in whom every being dwells.

quoteVariants.text: Undivided devotion reaches the supreme person. All beings live within that one.
One devotion reaches the One who pervades all.
Everything already rests in the one you seek.
Devotion reaches the one in all.
